revision_status.note: APPLIED=EDL mutated under safety; VERIFIED=accepted with vision; IMPROVED=verified+accepted+vision+semantic+safety+quality_delta. One model BETTER never auto-upgrades to IMPROVED. PTS/first-live/goal gates cannot be overridden by BETTER.

phase8_transition.note: candidate_accepted boolean does not drive this policy; formal release remains stricter than exploration. Budget does not discard the just-finished round outcome.

first_live_ledger.note: FRAME_BOUND_VALID ≠ FIRST_LIVE_VERIFIED. Hard-safety PASS needs independent broadcast-timeline review on every new window; binding-only stays UNKNOWN; REPLAY_CONFIRMED ⇒ FAIL.

disclaimer: Offline/dry-run does not claim real multimodal story understanding. release_authorized stays false unless hard gates + semantic pass. APPLIED ≠ VERIFIED ≠ IMPROVED.

delivery.note: Formal delivery requires release_authorized=true under full conjunction gates. workflow_completed / final_mp4_exists / semantic_verification_passed alone never authorize. HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED means a safe candidate preview exists for human judgment. RELEASE_READY requires FIRST_LIVE_VERIFIED on every final-delivery EDL goal (final_goal_evidence_manifest), not V3-R historical first-live stats.
